arxiv-1502-03414.title: Zeta and normal zeta functions for a subclass of space groups
arxiv-1502-03414.creator: Hermina ALAJBEGOVIĆ and Muharem AVDISPAHIĆ
arxiv-1502-03414.description: Abstract . We calculate zeta and normal zeta functions of space groups with the point group isomorphic to the cyclic group of order 2. The obtained results are applied to determine the number of subgroups, resp. normal subgroups, of a given index for each of these groups. Mathematics Subject Classification (2010) 11M41, 20H15 1.

arxiv-1804-05015.title: Large-scale diversity estimation through surname origin inference
arxiv-1804-05015.creator: Antoine Mazières \affilnum 1,2 and Camille Roth \affilnum 1,3
arxiv-1804-05015.description: Abstract The study of surnames as both linguistic and geographical markers of the past has proven valuable in several research fields spanning from biology and genetics to demography and social mobility. This article builds upon the existing literature to conceive and develop a surname origin classifier based on a data-driven typology.

arxiv-2012-03422.title: A General Conditional BER Expression of Rectangular QAM in the Presence of Phase Noise
arxiv-2012-03422.creator: Thanh V. Pham, Thang V. Nguyen, and Anh T. Pham
arxiv-2012-03422.description: Abstract In this paper, we newly present a closed-form bit-error rate (BER) expression for an M M -ary pulse-amplitude modulation ( M M -PAM) over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channels by analytically characterizing the bit decision regions and positions.

arxiv-2109-12003.title: Next-to-leading order QCD corrections to diphoton-plus-jet production through gluon fusion at the LHC Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2109-12003.creator: Simon Badger, Thomas Gehrmann, Matteo Marcoli, Ryan Moodie
arxiv-2109-12003.description: Abstract We compute the next-to-leading order (NLO) QCD corrections to the gluon-fusion subprocess of diphoton-plus-jet production at the LHC. We compute fully differential distributions by combining two-loop virtual corrections with one-loop real radiation using antenna subtraction to cancel infrared divergences.

arxiv-2207-05389.title: Holomorphic Factorization of Mappings into the Symplectic Group
arxiv-2207-05389.creator: Josua Schott
arxiv-2207-05389.description: Abstract It is shown that any symplectic 2 ​ n × 2 ​ n 2n\times 2n -matrix, whose entries are complex holomorphic functions on a reduced Stein space, can be decomposed into a finite product of elementary symplectic matrices if and only if it is null-homotopic.

arxiv-2210-03798.title: Computational performance of the M ​ M ​ O ​ C MMOC in the inverse design of the Doswell frontogenesis equation Journal: Computational and Applied Mathematics
arxiv-2210-03798.creator: Alexandre Francisco, Umberto Biccari, Enrique Zuazua
arxiv-2210-03798.description: Abstract Inverse design of transport equations can be addressed by using a gradient-adjoint methodology. In this methodology numerical schemes used for the adjoint resolution determine the direction of descent in its iterative algorithm, and consequently the C ​ P ​ U CPU time consumed by the inverse design.

arxiv-2404-07328.title: Affine super Yangians and deformed double current superalgebras
arxiv-2404-07328.creator: Nicolas Guay, Peggy Jankovic, Mamoru Ueda
arxiv-2404-07328.description: Abstract We extend to the super Yangian of the special linear Lie superalgebra 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 m | n \mathfrak{sl}_{m|n} and its affine version certain results related to Schur-Weyl duality. We do the same for the deformed double current superalgebra of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 m | n \mathfrak{sl}_{m|n} , which is introduced here for the first time.

arxiv-2405-18127.title: Graph Coarsening with Message-Passing Guarantees
arxiv-2405-18127.creator: Antonin Joly, Nicolas Keriven
arxiv-2405-18127.description: Abstract Graph coarsening aims to reduce the size of a large graph while preserving some of its key properties, which has been used in many applications to reduce computational load and memory footprint. For instance, in graph machine learning, training Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) on coarsened graphs leads to drastic savings in time and memory.

arxiv-2412-04553.title: On the signature of black holes on the quenched stellar mass function
arxiv-2412-04553.creator: Antonio J. Porras-Valverde, John C. Forbes
arxiv-2412-04553.description: Abstract As star-forming galaxies approach or exceed a stellar mass around 10 11 ​ M ⊙ 10^{11}M_{\odot} , they are increasingly likely to be quenched in a process generically called mass quenching. Central galaxies, which are quenched via mass rather than environmental quenching, therefore accumulate in a peak around this characteristic mass.

arxiv-2512-10225.title: Integrated Generation and Purification of Entangled Coherent States for Non-Gaussian Teleportation Publication type: Paper
arxiv-2512-10225.creator: Ananga Mohan Datta 1,∗ \orcid 0009-0009-2708-8712, William J. Munro 1 \orcid 0000-0003-1835-2250, Nicolò Lo Piparo 1 \orcid 0000-0002-0905-9485 and Kae Nemoto 1,2
arxiv-2512-10225.description: Abstract Entangled coherent states (ECS) provide a powerful non-Gaussian resource for continuous-variable quantum communication, but their generation in scalable architectures remains challenging. We propose an integrated photonic scheme that creates high-fidelity ECS from a two-mode squeezed vacuum via photon subtraction in a symmetric waveguide trimer.

arxiv-2512-17497.title: Towards Halbach Spheres – Icosahedral Symmetry Is Not Just Cool Anymore
arxiv-2512-17497.creator: Ingo Rehberg, Peter Blümler
arxiv-2512-17497.description: Abstract Halbach spheres provide a theoretically elegant means of generating highly homogeneous magnetic fields, but practical implementation is hindered by challenging fabrication and restricted interior access. This study examines discrete spherical Halbach configurations assembled from permanent magnets placed at the vertices of Platonic and Archimedean solids.

arxiv-2603-15766.title: Self-Consistent Nonlinear Classical Cepheid Pulsations During Stellar Evolution with MESA MESA ( Paxton et al. 2011 ; Paxton et al. 2013 ; Paxton et al. 2015 ; Paxton et al. 2018 ; Paxton et al. 2019 ; Jermyn et al. 2023 , https://docs.mesastar.org ) , MESASDK 20250801 ( Townsend 2019a ; Townsend 2019b ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , and mesa_reader ( Schwab et al. 2024 ) .

arxiv-2603-27792.title: What-If Explanations Over Time: Counterfactuals for Time Series Classification
arxiv-2603-27792.creator: Udo Schlegel, Thomas Seidl

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-david-william.title: David William Bacon (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-david-william.creator: Thomas Meehan
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-david-william.description: Article 'David William Bacon' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-11357606.title: Haloperidol for Pain Management: A Narrative Review
pmc-11357606.creator: Carlos J Roldan, Jonathan W Rowland, Alice L Ye, Przemyslaw Waszak, Paweł Zagożdżon
pmc-11357606.description: The use of haloperidol in pain management has been a topic of interest for several decades. Haloperidol is a widely used antipsychotic medication with unique pharmacologic properties that make it a potential candidate for pain management. However, the efficacy and safety of haloperidol for pain management remain controversial.

pmc-11425871.title: 3D genome contributes to MHC-II neoantigen prediction
pmc-11425871.creator: Mofan Feng, Liangjie Liu, Kai Su, Xianbin Su, Luming Meng, Zehua Guo, Dan Cao, Jiayi Wang, Guang He, Yi Shi
pmc-11425871.description: Reliable and ultra-fast DNA and RNA sequencing have been achieved with the emergence of high-throughput sequencing technology. When combining the results of DNA and RNA sequencing for tumor cells of cancer patients, neoantigens that potentially stimulate the immune response of either CD4+ or CD8+ T cells can be identified.

pmc-11477920.title: Design and Optimization of Nanoporous Materials as Catalysts for Oxygen Evolution Reaction—A Review
pmc-11477920.creator: Zhen Cao, Wenbin Zhang, Tingting Zhou, Wenhui Yan, Kaili Wang, Ioannis V Yentekakis
pmc-11477920.description: With the growing demand for new energy sources, electrochemical water splitting for hydrogen production is a technology that must be vigorously promoted. Therefore, to improve the efficiency of the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) at the anode, high-performance OER catalysts are essential. Given their advantages in electrocatalysis, nanoporous materials have garnered considerable attention in previous studies for OER applications.

pmc-11524163.title: Insights into prokaryotic communities and their potential functions in biogeochemical cycles in cold seep
pmc-11524163.creator: Qiumei Quan, Jiaxing Liu, Chaolun Li, Zhixin Ke, Yehui Tan
pmc-11524163.description: Microorganisms are significant drivers of organic matter mineralization and are essential in marine biogeochemical cycles. However, the variations and influencing factors in prokaryotic communities from cold-seep sediments to the water column and the specific role of these microorganisms in biogeochemical cycles in the water column above cold seep remain unclear.

pmc-11596016.title: Two-Dimensional Pentagonal Materials with Parabolic Dispersion and High Carrier Mobility
pmc-11596016.creator: Xiaofei Shao, Xiaobiao Liu, Xikui Ma, Spiros Gardelis
pmc-11596016.description: Materials with high carrier mobility, represented by graphene, have garnered significant interest. However, the zero band gap arising from linear dispersion cannot achieve an ideal on–off ratio in field-effect transistors (FETs), limiting practical applications in certain fields. In contrast, parabolic dispersion usually exhibits extremely high carrier mobility and an appropriate band gap.

pmc-11643222.title: Peroxiredoxin 4 Ameliorates T-2 Toxin-Induced Growth Retardation in GH3 Cells by Inhibiting Oxidative Stress and Apoptosis
pmc-11643222.creator: Qirong Lu, Yi Zhu, Luyao Wang, Meng Mei, Yinsheng Qiu, Yu Liu, Shulin Fu, Jianglin Xiong, Pu Guo, Zhongyuan Wu, Xu Wang
pmc-11643222.description: T-2 toxin, a highly toxic type A trichothecene, is a secondary fungal metabolite produced by various Fusarium species. The consumption of food and feed contaminated with T-2 toxin is a major factor contributing to growth retardation, posing significant risks to both human and animal health. However, the specific targets and mechanisms that mitigate T-2 toxin-induced growth retardation remain unclear.

pmc-12613893.title: 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequences from coastal sediments at the Sonoran Desert and Gulf of California interface
pmc-12613893.creator: Cristal Ramos-Madrigal, Esperanza Martínez-Romero, Yunuen Tapia-Torres, Luis E. Servín-Garcidueñas
pmc-12613893.description: We report the taxonomic composition of bacterial and archaeal communities from sand and salt-crust sediments in the coastal Sonoran Desert, Mexico. Analysis of 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequences revealed Halobacterota, Bacteroidota, and Proteobacteria as dominant phyla, providing a resource to explore microbial diversity in extreme environments.

pmc-12653394.title: Integrated Management Strategies for Wood Infested by Hylurgus ligniperda F. (Coleoptera: Curculionidae: Scolytinae)
pmc-12653394.creator: Huanwen Chen, Xiaowei Chen, Dan Xie, Qingshan Yang, Fang Niu, Defu Chi, Jia Yu, Christos G Athanassiou
pmc-12653394.description: Simple SummaryThe red-haired bark beetle is a destructive forest pest that is spreading globally. A major challenge in its management is the safe disposal of infested trees to prevent further dispersal. Our study demonstrates that sulfuryl fluoride is highly effective, requiring only a quarter of the dosage of aluminum phosphide to achieve mortality, even against the fumigation-resistant egg stage.

pmc-13198034.title: Community and stakeholder engagement in national priority setting and participatory research for HIV, Tuberculosis, and Malaria programs in Nepal
pmc-13198034.creator: Sandesh Neupane, Rupa Shiwakoti, Laxman Aryal, Masauso Nzima, Ivana Lohar, Achut Sitaula, Ujjwal Karmacharya, Krishna Paudel, Anuj Bhattachan, Sudha Devkota, Rajan Kumar Bhattarai, Bipin Adhikari
pmc-13198034.description: BackgroundFollowing Nepal’s transition to a federal governance system under the 2015 Constitution and the COVID-19 pandemic, the Country Coordinating Mechanism (CCM) led a participatory process to identify national priorities for HIV, Tuberculosis (TB), and Malaria programs. The primary objective of this study was to analyze, in collaboration with community partners, the community and stakeholder engagement processes involved in priority setting.

pmc-13383410.title: Physical contact under surveillance: cultural norms, visibility and teacher self-regulation ın Türkiye
pmc-13383410.creator: Damla Güler, Semiyha Tuncel
pmc-13383410.description: BackgroundPhysical contact in physical education represents a complex pedagogical practice shaped not only by instructional needs but also by broader social, cultural, and professional expectations. In contexts where bodily interaction may be subject to social interpretation and potential misunderstanding, teachers continuously negotiate appropriate forms of pedagogical touch.

pmc-13418482.title: Natural molecule potentiates colistin efficacy in vivo via modulating adaptive LPS modifications and ferroptotic-like damages
pmc-13418482.creator: Hui-Hui Zhang, Yi-Dan Cao, Ying-Ying Xie, Yu-Ze Li, Xiao-Na Fan, Qiu-Yue Diao, Yu-Jiao Liang, Li-Ren He, Zi-Xing Zhong, Li-Juan Xia, Ze-Hua Cui, Xiao-Ping Liao, Xin-Lei Lian, Dong-Hao Zhao, Jian Sun, Hao Ren

pmc-13425532.title: A liposome–hydrogel composite ameliorates UVB-induced mouse skin photoaging through integrated antioxidant and extracellular matrix remodeling pathways
pmc-13425532.creator: Yifan Liu, Kejia Chen, Jin Pei, Qi Song, Xinlu Wang, Chuhan Ma, Yao Li, Liangping Yu
pmc-13425532.description: Skin photoaging, predominantly caused by chronic ultraviolet B (UVB) exposure, is characterized by oxidative stress, collagen degradation, and disruption of the skin barrier. Deer placenta polypeptides (DPP) are rich in bioactive amino acids (AAs); however, their antioxidant and dermo-protective effects remain insufficiently elucidated, and their topical application is limited by enzymatic instability and poor transdermal permeability.

pmc-13443198.title: The molecular regulation of axillary bud fate determination and outgrowth into branch crown in strawberry involves BRC1
pmc-13443198.creator: Marie Alonso, Pierre Prévost, Aline Potier, Pascal GP Martin, Yves Caraglio, Michael Nicolas, Michel Hernould, Christophe Rothan, Béatrice Denoyes, Amèlia Gaston

pmc-13458019.title: Collapsing Glomerulopathy in a Patient With Malaria and Multiple Myeloma: A Case Report
pmc-13458019.creator: Moritz Harenberg, Kerstin Amann, Daniel Zickler, Semonti Nandi
pmc-13458019.description: Collapsing glomerulopathy is a severe form of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) that can occur as a primary or secondary condition, often in the context of infections such as HIV. Multiple myeloma can cause kidney injury through mechanisms such as cast nephropathy, while malaria‐associated kidney injury is most often due to acute tubular necrosis.

pmc-13526813.title: Neural Excitation–Inhibition Imbalance in Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy
pmc-13526813.creator: Hongqing Wu, Kun Zhu, Haoxiang Wang, Qiu Guo, Zhichao Luo, Sichen Bian, Bingyong Xie, Haoyu Ni, Yuanyuan Wu, Yongqiang Yu, Fulong Dong
pmc-13526813.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCervical spondylotic myelopathy (CSM) is a chronic spinal cord compression disorder associated with degenerative changes in the cervical spine. Although morphological alterations in brain regions associated with CSM have been reported, the underlying molecular regulatory mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study aims to reveal the structural changes among different brain regions in CSM and their complex associations with specific transcriptional expression patterns.MethodsThe study includes 170 CSM patients and 79 healthy controls(age range: 40-65 years).

pmc-13578252.title: Targeting NLRP3 with GDC-2394 ameliorates airway inflammation and smooth muscle hyperplasia in experimental asthma by suppressing the IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 axis
pmc-13578252.creator: Zhiyuan Wang, Zhenzhen Guo, Yanan Wang, Qianqian Dai, Muhammad Imran Arif, Aizetiguli Maiming, Menghua Li, Aliya Maimaitiniyazi, Xueli Wang, Jianjiang Cui, Shengmeng Qu, Wen Zhao, Liang Ru

pmc-13659308.title: Resolution of proximal tubular dysfunction after liver transplantation in ATP8B1 deficiency: A case report
pmc-13659308.creator: Angela Marino, Nathalie Godefroid, Catherine De Magnée, Xavier Stephenne
pmc-13659308.description: Progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis type 1 (PFIC1), caused by ATP8B1 deficiency, is a multisystem disorder with extrahepatic manifestations; however, renal involvement has rarely been described. We report a child with genetically confirmed PFIC1 who underwent living donor liver transplantation (LT) for progressive liver disease.

uslaw-usc-t49-s20701.title: 49 U.S.C. § 20701 — Requirements for use
uslaw-usc-t49-s20701.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s20701.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Safety); Chapter 207 (Locomotives). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A railroad carrier may use or allow to be used a locomotive or tender on its railroad line only when the locomotive or tender and its parts and appurtenances— (1) are in proper condition and safe to operate without unnecessary danger of personal injury; (2).
